name: Valhalla
description: An open source routing engine and accompanying libraries for use with OpenStreetMap data. Valhalla also includes tools like time+distance matrix computation, isochrones, elevation sampling, map matching and tour optimization (Travelling Salesman).

paths.name: GTFS Feeds
paths.description: Path to GTFS feeds. Remove if Build Transit is disabled.

variables.name: Tile URLs
variables.description: Space-separated list of URLs. Remove if Use Local Tiles is enabled.

variables.name: Use Local Tiles
variables.description: Use a local tile.tar file instead of downloading and building

variables.name: Build Tar
variables.description: True creates a tarball of the tiles including an index which allows for extremely faster graph loading after reboots. Force will do the same, but first delete the existing tarball.

variables.name: Force Rebuild
variables.description: Force a rebuild of the routing tiles and sets (overrides Build Tar)

variables.name: Build Elevation
variables.description: True downloads elevation tiles which are covering the routing graph. Force will do the same, but first delete any existing elevation tiles.

variables.name: Build Admins
variables.description: True builds the admin database needed for things like border-crossing penalties and detailed routing responses. Force will do the same, but first delete the existing database.

variables.name: Build Time Zones
variables.description: True builds the timezone database which is needed for time-dependent routing. Force will do the same, but first delete the existing database.

variables.name: Build Transit
variables.description: True will attempt to build transit tiles if none exist yet. Force will remove existing transit and routing tiles.

variables.name: Tileset Name
variables.description: The name of the resulting graph on disk. Very useful in case you want to build multiple datasets in the same directory.

variables.name: Traffic Name
variables.description: The name of the traffic.tar. Again, useful for serving multiple traffic archives from the same directory. If empty, no traffic archive will be built.

variables.name: Path Extensions
variables.description: This path will be appended to the custom_files path and will be the directory where all files will be created. Can be very useful in certain deployment scenarios. No leading/trailing path separator allowed.

variables.name: Update Existing Config
variables.description: True updates missing keys in existing valhalla.json. Useful for updating stale config files to include newly introduced config parameters.

variables.name: Use Default Speed Config
variables.description: True loads a JSON file used to enhance default speeds (or falls back to an existing custom_files/default_speeds.json) and sets the respective config entry. More details: https://github.com/OpenStreetMapSpeeds/schema

variables.name: Default Speed Config URL
variables.description: Remote location of the default_speeds_config JSON.

variables.name: Serve Tiles
variables.description: Serve tiles from the container. If false, only build the graph.

variables.name: Server Threads
variables.description: Number of threads to use for the server
